headline: Gulveer Singh and Harjinder Kaur each secured silver medals for India on Day 5 of the Commonwealth Games 2026, boosting the nation’s tally.
Teen swimmer Anushka Yadav, a farmer’s daughter, set a new Indian national record, becoming the youngest ever holder of a national athletics mark.
Neeraj Chopra was named Best Male Athlete at the Indian Athletics Awards 2025, recognized as the nation’s top male track‑and‑field star.
Sports Minister Mansukh Mandaviya emphasized India’s ambition to host the 2036 Olympic Games, outlining the country’s strategic push in the upcoming years.
